title: [F9.4] Audio-file import bypasses the 3-piece free save limit (no paywall, unlimited free saves)
[P1.5] Paywall/review notes promise "free: first 30 s, Pro: full-length" imports but neither limit exists (all files up to 60 s are free, longer fail for everyone)
[F9.6] Import failures show one generic message: >60 s files, videos without audio and conversion errors are indistinguishable
[P7.4] Pro stays unlocked after the subscription expires until the app is relaunched
[P5.3] Ask to Buy approval does not close the open paywall (user stays on the purchase screen while already Pro)
[P2.8] Settings "Go Pro" opens the full purchase paywall even when the user already has Pro (can buy a second product)
[P6.2] Restore Purchases in Settings gives no feedback (no success, no "nothing found", no failure message)
[P6.4] Cancelling the App Store sign-in during Restore shows "Restore failed: <raw system text>"
[P4.2] Purchase failures show raw system text; an unverified transaction shows "The operation couldn't be completed (EarSheet.ProStoreError error 0)"
[P10.2] Purchase funnel analytics log cancel and Ask-to-Buy pending as `purchase_fail`, and there are no paywall dismiss/trigger/restore-tap events
[F3.3] Microphone permission denied: message says "Enable it in Settings" but offers no Open Settings button, only "Back to library"
[F4.3] Transcription pump failure shows an error but the microphone keeps recording
[F4.7] No way to cancel a listening session: the only control is Stop, which saves a take (and consumes a free slot); nothing at all during "Warming up…"
[F5.6] Unsaved (held) take is silently discarded by the "Library" back button
[F7.3] Session WAV files are written before the outcome is known and leak (~2.6 MB per 60 s) after failed, held-and-discarded or restarted sessions
[F7.1] An unreadable takes.json silently empties the Library and the next save overwrites it for good; write failures are never shown
[F9.2] Importing audio/video shows no progress at all, cannot be cancelled, and an empty/silent file returns silently

[F9.5] At the free limit, a held imported piece is invisible: dismissing the paywall (or the suppressed-paywall notice) leaves it unrecoverable, a later import silently replaces it, and a later Pro flip pops it up unexpectedly
[F9.8] Picked audio/MIDI/video temp copies are never (or only sometimes) deleted
[F10.3] MP3 export shows no progress; `isPreparing` is set but never read, so the row can be tapped repeatedly and starts parallel renders
[F10.6] Export file names drop every non-ASCII character: a take titled "夜曲" exports as ".pdf" / ".mid" (empty base name)
[F10.7] Developer "Debug export" UI ships to everyone and silently overwrites the clipboard with the full note JSON
[F12.6] Settings "Measure now" never checks microphone permission and fails silently
[F4.6] Backgrounding or locking the phone while listening is unhandled (no scenePhase logic, no background audio mode); interruptions are invisible
[F4.4] The "Reached the 60-second recording limit" notice is set during writing and is dismissed with the screen, so the user is never told why recording stopped
[P10.4] No PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy in the app target although the app uses UserDefaults and sends anonymous usage/purchase data
[P11.1] App Review notes point to the wrong Settings position, repeat the unimplemented "full-length imports" claim, and give no microphone/no-mic test guidance
[P11.2] Store copy says it "writes the score live" / "Live Audio to Sheet Music" but the live screen shows a piano roll only; the staff appears after Stop (owner decision)
[F2.5] New takes can get a duplicate default title ("Take 3" twice) after a delete
[P1.8] Dismissing a paywall the user opened themselves ("Keep it" banner / dialog) counts toward the automatic-prompt caps
[F13.1] Raw Swift/Foundation error descriptions are interpolated into user-facing messages
[F1.5] Onboarding says "Nothing ever leaves your phone" but the app sends a device record, usage events (default on) and purchase transactions

[P1.9] Enhancement (product decision): one shared upgrade-prompt policy wired to every designed trigger (save limit, import limit, export locked row, 3rd transcription, settings) with Pro/in-flight/first-session suppression
[P1.11] Enhancement (product decision): when a free user imports a file longer than 30 s, offer "Write the first 30 s free" or "Try Pro" before transcribing (design screen 7)
[P2.1] Enhancement (product decision): soft "Export this as MIDI & MusicXML" interstitial (with a free-PDF alternative) before the full paywall on the first export
[P1.12] Enhancement (product decision): dismissible inline Library card after the 3rd saved piece (rank 4: shows once, may return once after 14 days)
[P1.10] Enhancement (product decision): show how many free saves are left ("2 of 3 pieces saved") in the Library, with a gentle note on the last free slot
[P3.5] Enhancement (product decision): after a purchase show a short confirmation (plan, trial end date if any) and resume the export the user tapped
[P9.4] Enhancement (product decision): Pro status detail (plan, renews/expires date) in Settings and a quiet "Go Pro" entry in the Library toolbar for free users
